contexts.text: The Ancient Church is signified by beginnings ().
Every state before a man is instructed is a beginning, and when he begins to be instructed, it is a beginning.
All men from the beginning were celestial.

The first state of the perversion of the Church, which exists when they begin no longer to know what good and truth are, but dispute together about them, whence arise falsities, (is signified by) the end is not yet, and that these are the beginning of sorrows ().
When a man is in the affection of truth, in which he is in the beginning, before he is being regenerated...
All uses in their beginning are truths of doctrine.
That law was the beginning of the Word...
The two beginnings (of spaces and times), which are immensity and eternity...
The beginnings of them are from God.
Spiritual thoughts the beginnings and origins of natural thoughts.
